authorized_mutations: deploy or replace the single Cloudflare Worker named tmg-video-kong-mcp-canary from the merged request SHA
acceptance: health must read back the exact merged Git SHA
health must prove MCP enabled and public API disabled
health must prove tool execution disabled and no data bindings present
tools/call must be rejected by the upstream canary
artifact must contain Worker URL, deployment SHA, health evidence, MCP discovery evidence, and rollback-required=true
explicitly_not_authorized: R2, Vectorize, Workflow, Durable Object, database, or media binding creation
